verdict.rationale: Tavily's own Extract endpoint pulls page content from one or more URLs, batching up to 20 per request and reporting per-URL failures. It is also available in the SDKs, CLI and MCP server, and Crawl includes built-in extraction, so developers can get page content beyond search snippets. However, the evidence never explicitly says 'full text' or 'markdown'. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of markdown or full-text output formats, evidence of raw page content returned inline with search results, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction completeness.
